subsystem.name: VehicleAIAndPit
subsystem.responsibility: Pit-machine state recording and pit-stop operation timing, pit-repair HUD formatting, AI driver/opponent selection and count setup, engine-failure handling, tire graphics mesh loading and tire temperature simulation, and pit-stop order data loading.

summary: The vehicle-AI-and-pit subsystem centers on the F1CPitMachine object (this base): a state machine that records transitions into a 432-byte-strided ring buffer (StateChangeNotify, PitsUnderRedHandler) and a per-frame pit-stop operation timing coordinator that accumulates operation durations from part/crew/tire/wheel-gun sub-tasks (PitStopOperationTimer). AI driver management is split between opponent candidate selection into a merge-sorted linked list (BuildOpponentList), init-time count/nationality/team setup (AIDriverCountSetup), a session-type flag key classifier (KeyPriorityChain), and per-vehicle engine-failure/collision handling (EngineFailureCheck). Vehicle tire and wheel presentation is covered by a per-wheel-position mesh loader gated by detail level (TireWheelGraphicsMeshLoader) and a per-frame tire temperature simulation (TireTemperatureSimStep). Pit data management includes a career-standings teardown and tire-wear getter (PitStopMemoryCleanup, TireWearGetter), a pit-order data loader with reversible iteration (PitStopOrderLoader) and a driver race-position rank (PitStopOrderRank). Ownership is confirmed in-packet only for F1CPitMachine (three functions); all other class identities are DERIVED from shared field bases and call relationships and must not be promoted without independent evidence.

function_roles.role: Loads tire/wheel graphics mesh references (.MTS) per wheel position selected by tire-name match (LF/RF/LR/RR), parsing lodin/lodout LOD bounds and applying the caller detail level as a range gate, then allocating 72-byte mesh records and linking them into the per-position singly linked list rooted at a5 + 4*wheelIndex; recurses for nested instance meshes.

Formats and refreshes the pit-repair HUD widget: fuel/time basis computation and fuel quantity string, current part-name resolution through the string table, repair progress counter formatting, and Repair/Do-Not-Repair plus part-label string selection driven by internal mode flags and a vtable-provided part count.

Pit-machine state-change recorder: reads the current state at this+0x184, returns unchanged on equal state, optionally stamps session time dbl_8AFEA0 into this+0x18C, advances the ring-buffer write cursor dword_8AAE64 (bounded by dword_83EE60 < 1023, 432-byte stride), encodes a progress-bar event of type 6 from the event id at this+4, writes the new state at entry+8, and dispatches the AI state machine.

One-shot handler for entering pits under a red flag: guarded by latch this+0x180, records the state change to 2 via StateChangeNotify, captures the owner vehicle pointer, updates the AI session phase, processes the vehicle pit state, and under the race-start gate (dword_8ACFC8==2) with penalties enabled either disqualifies the driver (session type 7) or applies a time penalty.

Per-frame pit-stop operation timing and sequence coordinator: clears the operation-progress block, advances the vehicle progress bar through the physics channel when a pit stop is active, otherwise computes the max duration across base time, part changes, tire-change transitions, wheel-gun operations and audio/visual effect gates, dispatching ConditionalMathDispatch, part resolution, ProgressBarEventEncode and audio effect handling; returns 0.0 while the vehicle pit state obj+0x32C8 is 1 and the blocking condition holds.

Priority-ordered session-type classifier: calls SessionTypeFlagGuard on byte_7CA594 with flags 203, 200, 208 and 205, short-circuiting to keys 0, 1, 3, 4 respectively and defaulting to 2; global-state only, consumed by sub_4B9890 and ConditionalMultiPathDispatcher.

Per-vehicle AI engine-failure and collision loop over the car array: guards engine-state flags, applies random variation scaling to negative speed, triggers collision response with a probability-ladder severity, accumulates damage counters and pit-crew progress-bar events, re-enters per car until the remaining count is exhausted, then advances the session-time accumulator and drives the AI tick update.

Builds the AI opponent candidate list: logs a NotAI debug line, may short-circuit via AIPathPerformanceFunction for a2 <= 10, randomly walks the vehicle roster modulo the count from dword_8AC36C, accepts candidates into 8-byte nodes wrapped in 12-byte linked-list nodes appended to a head/tail/iter/count list on 'this', then splits and merge-sorts the list by the float value at node+4; returns the number of candidates appended.

Configures the AI opponent count and per-driver nationality/team assignment at dynamic-manager init: builds the driver-name path, applies a championship single-vehicle override or a deterministic random count, selects opponents via AIOpponentSelection, walks the vehicle array assigning nationality and team id, and always ends with the single-player fallback (name lookup, nationality, team 0, final session transition).

Career-standings structure teardown: frees two dynamically allocated pointers guarded against null at byte offsets 0xB128 and 0xB120, then runs sub_49A270 cleanup on 104 contiguous per-driver blocks stepping downward by 0x1B4 bytes from byte 0xAF6C down to byte 0.
Trivial thiscall getter returning the int field at this+0xB14C; no side effects, no callees, no guards; called from SessionInit.

Conditional wrapper that, when argument a2 is non-zero, zero-initializes a stack struct, opens an audio stream for a2, and only on success writes options via GameOptionsWriter, conditionally closes the file handle and always runs conditional-field cleanup before returning the stored writer flag.

Per-frame tire temperature simulation on a vehicle: skips vehicle types above 1, gated by the session-state check on dword_7CD25C, clamps the temperature field this+0x48B8 to [0.0, 5.0], subtracts the cooling rate dbl_8AFE90 and recovers via ClampedPhysicsScaleWithThreshold using the team field this+0x4894, then dispatches car lighting/render through the 432-byte-strided ring buffer and runs the this+3 sub-object update.

Boolean check over a dynamically indexed child object: reads the index at this+0x1C, loads the child pointer at this[this[7]+8], returns 0 when null, otherwise dispatches a virtual thiscall at vtable offset 28 of the child and returns 0 when the result equals 2, else 1; called from RendererSceneNodeUpdate.

Loads and parses pit-stop order data for teams: gated on AudioChannelStop(aPitorder), resets the team entry count this+0x1A8, walks the string-keyed team linked list storing DataEntryAccessor results, allocates a count-strided array (entries {0,-1}) into this+0x1AC, and reallocs each team string in forward or reverse order depending on the reverse-pit-order setting.

Computes a driver's race position by counting active drivers ranking ahead via DriverStandingComparator (rank + 1), or by reading a stored position directly from the vehicle array at dword_5F0738[4656*a2] when the session type is 7.

classes.name: F1CPitMachine
classes.responsibility: Pit-stop machine: records state transitions into a ring buffer, runs per-frame pit-stop operation timing, formats the pit-repair HUD, handles pits-under-red, and loads pit-stop order data.

classes.name: Vehicle
classes.responsibility: Per-vehicle state object carrying pit state, pit-stop type, pit-block and audio flags, plus tire temperature and thermal model fields; fields are evidenced under two bases ('obj' from pit-machine accessors, 'this' from the temperature simulator's own this pointer) and are kept distinct because common ownership is not proven by the packet.

classes.name: VehicleTireMeshLoader
classes.responsibility: Parses tire/wheel graphics mesh definitions (.MTS) and builds per-wheel-position singly linked lists of mesh records gated by detail level.

classes.name: SessionTypeClassifier
classes.responsibility: Maps the session-type flag byte to a small priority key used to select multi-path dispatch.

classes.name: AIEngineFailureManager
classes.responsibility: Per-vehicle engine-failure and collision handling: speed randomization, severity-ladder collision response, damage accumulation, engine-state gating and pit-crew progress-bar events.

classes.name: AIOpponentSelection
classes.responsibility: Builds, counts, splits and merge-sorts the linked list of AI opponent candidates (head/tail/iter/count stored on 'this'; 8-byte candidate nodes with an accessor value and float parameter wrapped in 12-byte list nodes).

classes.name: AIDriverSetup
classes.responsibility: Init-time AI driver count, opponent selection, and per-driver nationality/team assignment, with the single-player fallback path.

classes.name: CareerStandings
classes.responsibility: Career-standings structure holding two guarded allocations and 104 per-driver blocks plus a tire-wear value read at byte 0xB14C.

classes.name: GameOptionsIO
classes.responsibility: Wraps option writing behind an audio-stream-open gate with conditional file-handle close and cleanup.

classes.name: VirtualStateNode
classes.responsibility: Boolean state check over a dynamically indexed child object using an index field and a virtual method at vtable offset 28.

classes.name: DriverStandingCalculator
classes.responsibility: Computes a driver's race position either by counting ahead drivers through the standing comparator or from a stored position array for session type 7.

state_machines.name: F1CPitMachineState
states: 1: active pit phase (timestamp stamped on entry, pit-stop timing active)
2: entering/exit transitional phase (timestamp stamped on entry from a state other than 1)
transitions: any -> 1: StateChangeNotify(a2==1) stamps dbl_8AFEA0 into this+0x18C and dispatches the AI state machine
state != 1 -> 2: StateChangeNotify(a2==2) stamps dbl_8AFEA0 into this+0x18C and dispatches the AI state machine
any -> 2 (first occurrence): PitsUnderRedHandler records the state change to 2 and sets the one-shot latch this+0x180

interfaces.name: IPitStateRecorder
interfaces.purpose: Record pit-machine state transitions into the 432-byte-strided ring buffer and dispatch the AI state machine on each newly recorded entry.

interfaces.name: ISessionTypeClassifier
interfaces.purpose: Classify the session-type flag byte into a small priority key used by multi-path dispatch and driver setup decisions.

interfaces.name: IVehicleFramePass
interfaces.purpose: Per-frame per-vehicle simulation step invoked by the IterateVehicles pass.

compatibility_contracts.name: PitMachineStateRingBuffer
compatibility_contracts.description: Pit-machine state changes are recorded into a ring buffer with a 432-byte entry stride; the new state is stored at entry+8. The write pointer dword_8AAE64 advances by the stride only while the bounded counter dword_83EE60 < 1023, and each entry encodes a progress-bar event of type 6 using the machine event id at +4 and the session-time global dbl_8AFEA0.

compatibility_contracts.name: PitStopOperationTiming
compatibility_contracts.description: The per-frame pit-stop timing coordinator returns the accumulated operation duration except that it returns 0.0 while the vehicle pit state obj+0x32C8 equals 1 and PitStopBlockingCondition holds. The detail-level gate global dword_7CF884 >= 2 forces mesh loading regardless of LOD bounds in the tire mesh loader.

compatibility_contracts.name: SessionTypeFlagKeys
compatibility_contracts.description: The session-type flag byte_7CA594 is classified via SessionTypeFlagGuard into keys: flag 203 maps to 0, 200 to 1, 208 to 3, 205 to 4, and anything else defaults to 2.

compatibility_contracts.name: TireTemperatureModel
compatibility_contracts.description: Per-frame tire temperature: the field +0x48B8 is clamped to [0.0, 5.0], reduced by the cooling rate dbl_8AFE90, and on dropping to zero is recovered via ClampedPhysicsScaleWithThreshold using the team field +0x4894 (max(-scale, scale + temp)); vehicle types above 1 are skipped.

compatibility_contracts.name: OpponentSelectionAndSort
compatibility_contracts.description: Builds an opponent candidate list by randomly walking the vehicle roster modulo the count read from dword_8AC36C, accepting up to a2 candidates, each an 8-byte node (accessor value + float parameter computed by sub_4BF6A0) wrapped in a 12-byte list node; the list is then split at its midpoint and merge-sorted by the float value at candidate node+4.

compatibility_contracts.name: DriverRacePosition
compatibility_contracts.description: Race position equals the number of active drivers ranking ahead (via DriverStandingComparator) plus one; for session type 7 the stored position is read directly from the dword_5F0738 vehicle-position array indexed by 4656*a2 instead.

compatibility_contracts.name: PitStopOrderData
compatibility_contracts.description: Team pit-stop order is loaded into an array of 8*count+4 bytes with a leading count slot and per-entry pairs initialized to {0, -1}; iteration order is reversible (forward or reverse pit order) selected by comparing aReversepitorde against aFalse_0, and each team string is realloc-copied per entry.

compatibility_contracts.name: PitsUnderRedHandling
compatibility_contracts.description: Entering the pits under a red flag is a one-shot handler: on first pass it records the state change to 2, captures the owner vehicle, updates the AI session phase and vehicle pit state; when the race-start gate dword_8ACFC8 equals 2 and penalties are enabled (dword_7CEF84), session type 7 disqualifies the driver via DisqualificationHandler while other sessions apply a time penalty via sub_4BBA90(aEnteringPitsUn, 1000.0).

unresolved: F1CPitMachine ownership is CONFIRMED in-packet for 0x004A5C80, 0x004A5EA0 and 0x004A6340; every other class identity here (Vehicle, AIOpponentSelection, CareerStandings, etc.) is DERIVED from shared field bases and call relationships and must be treated as a proposal, not runtime truth.
The exact meanings of pit-machine state values 1 and 2, the 432-byte ring-buffer entry layout beyond +8, and the semantics of dbl_8AFEA0 (session time) are not proven by this packet.

Field 0x32C8 is evidenced under two bases: obj+0x32C8 (vehicle pit state from pit-machine accessors) and this+0x32C8 (vehicle type gate from the temperature simulator); common ownership is not proven, so they are kept as distinct fields.

sub_588410 match semantics (nonzero-on-match vs strcmp-style zero-on-match) are unverified; the tire-name guard in TireWheelGraphicsMeshLoader yields only the lftire->1 / else->0 reachable path despite the apparent LF/RF/LR/RR to 0/1/2/3 mapping.

AIDriverCountSetup stride 18624 per slot and the exact per-slot field touched by TeamIDSetter are not visible in this packet; globals unk_5EC6D0, unk_5EC6E4 and unk_8AC388 roles are unverifiable.
